title: The Description says 150C but it maybe reaches 150F
text: The Description says 150C but it maybe reaches 150F. This was a very light and easy to use iron, HOWEVER it LIES in the product description and on the pamphlet inside the product, when it says it heats up to 150C.  I wasn't brave enough to put my hand on it (too much trauma from getting burned by irons when I was a kid) but it never got hot enough to sizzle a splash of water, which was always a secondary way of telling the iron was hot enough, and that was when I had it on highest temp. and let it heat up for more than 15 minutes.  I had to return this to get one that definitely has a steam function (so I knew that was getting hot enough).  All I wanted it for was for  hem tape and iron-on applications.
